mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT remains stuck below -20 percent for four consecutive weeks, signalling suppressed commuting and discretionary trip-making; with no transit recovery, footfall to retail-and-recreation venues stays weak, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while TRANSIT stays at or below -20 percent in every week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES crossed below -14 in the last two weeks, a loss of office presence that removes weekday lunchtime and after-work retail demand; continued low WORKPLACES drags RETAIL_REC down over two weeks.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES is below -14 for two consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than in the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS improvement to -6.3 combined with TRANSIT stuck near -26 shows outdoor recreation substituting for indoor discretionary trips; while this substitution regime holds, RETAIL_REC is pulled lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days whenever PARKS >= -10 and TRANSIT <= -22 at the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL stays above 14 while WORKPLACES falls below -14, a work-from-home configuration that keeps daytime populations in residential areas and suppresses trips to retail-and-recreation destinations, lowering RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL > 14 and WORKPLACES < -14, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not lower than the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM remains positive for four straight weeks while RETAIL_REC is negative, showing essential spending resilience; as grocery stockpiling fades, released household budget shifts toward discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is above 2.0 at decision point, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has improved from -18.7 to -6.3, but September seasonal transition will reduce outdoor recreation and shift spending indoors; this seasonal rotation raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when PARKS is above -10 at the September decision point.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT at or below -25 and WORKPLACES at or below -14 signal active travel-avoidance guidance; this policy-constrained regime cuts non-essential retail trips immediately, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the next 7 days is not lower than in the prior 7 days when TRANSIT <= -25 and WORKPLACES <= -14.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC's one-week dip from -14.9 to -17.6 is noise because PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both improved over the prior two weeks; the underlying mobility recovery continues, so RETAIL_REC rebounds over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than the prior 14 days after a one-week dip below -17 following a week above -15.
